items.title: Buddy Hield was awesome for the Bahamas today as they were pushed by Uruguay. Hield went for 28 points, 7 rebounds, 4 assists and 2 steals.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Buddy Hield was awesome for the Bahamas today as they were pushed by Uruguay. Hield went for 28 points, 7 rebounds, 4 assists and 2 steals.

Former NBAers Isaiah Mobley and Kai Jones had strong games too. Mobley put up 18/5/2 and 2 blocks. Jones had 10 points and 5 rebounds.

items.title: One way the Hawks could still take advantage of the Wolves situation is by receiving a pick (probably not much of a pick, but still) to trade Josh Green for Buddy Hield and Devin Carter. Wolves could stretch Carter, keep Hield. Also works with Ryan Nembhard in Carter's place.
